records.synonym_note: Chamaesyce maculata (L.) Small and Anisophyllum maculatum (L.) Haw. homotypic synonyms; Chamaesyce supina heterotypic synonym. Distinct accepted species from E. hypericifolia; historical E. hypericifolia var. maculata Klotzsch belongs under E. hypericifolia, not evidence to merge them.
